ZONINGLOTDEVELOPMENTANDEASEMENTAGREEMENT KINGSCOUNTY BL0CK 1114, TENATIVE TAX LOTS 1 AND 9, ANDEXISTING TAX LOT 7 RECORDANDRETURN TO: Cullen and Dykman LLP 44 Wall Street, 17th Floor NewYork,NY 10005 Attn: Paul A. Michels, Esq.

ZONINGLOTDEVELOPMENTANDEASEMENTAGREEMENT THIS ZONING LOT DEVELOPMENT AND EASEMENT AGREEMENT (this "Agreement"), made as of this ↓ day of J1   between 235 PPW, LLC, a Delaware limited liability company having an office at 862 Broadway, New York, New York 10003 ("Developer") and THE ROMAN CATHOLIC CHURCH OF YORK, a religious corporation formed under the Religious Corporation Law of the State of New York, having an address at 245 Prospect Park West, Brooklyn, New York 11215 ("Holy Name"). RECITALS: WHEREAS, Holy Name is the fee owner of certain land having a designation of Tax Lot 1 and Tax Lot 7 in Block 1114 on the Tax Map ofthe City of New York, County of Kings, as more particularly described and depicted in Exhibit A annexed hereto and made a part hereof, together with the buildings and improvements thereon existing as of the date hereof (saidland being herein referred to as the“HolyName Land") WHEREAS, pursuant to a certain Agreement of Lease (the “Lease'"), dated as of October 23, 2021, Holy Name, as landlord, leased to Developer, as tenant, the portion of the Holy Name Land as described and depicted in Exhibit B annexed hereto and made a part hereof (the "Developer Land") (which Developer Land has the property address known as 235 Prospect Park West,Brooklyn,NewYork and adesignation of Tentative Tax Lot 9 in Block 1114 on theTax Map of the City of New York, County of Kings), together with the 4-story existing building (former convent) and improvements existing on the Developer Land as of the date of the Lease (the "Existing Leased Building"); WHEREAS, pursuant to the Lease, Holy Name proposes to subdivide Tax Lot 1 to create two (2) tax lot designations such that the Holy Name Land shall be comprised of (i) the portion of the Holy Name Land that is today generally improved with a school (with an address at 241 Prospect Park West), an ancillary office building (with an address at 243 Prospect Park West), the Holy Name of Jesus Church (with an address at 247 Prospect Park West) and a parking lot, such land to be designated as Tax Lot 1 in Block 1114 on the Tax Map (hereinafter referred to as "Reapportioned Tax Lot 1'") and (i) the remaining portion of the Holy Name Land that presently contains the Existing Leased Building, the boundaries of which coincide with the boundaries of the Developer Land, which shall be designated as Tax Lot 9 in Block 1114 on the Tax Map; WHEREAS, the rectory (with an address of 245 Prospect Park West) located on Tax Lot 7 together with the existing buildings described above on Reapportioned Tax Lot 1 shall collectively hereinafter be referred to as “Holy Name Existing Buildings,” and Reapportioned Tax Lot 1 together with Tax Lot 7 shall hereinafter be referred to as“Retained Holy Name Land" and all as depicted on Exhibit C hereto.The Retained Holy Name Land together with the buildings located thereon shall hereinafter be referred to as “Holy Name Property."
